# People of Fenmoor
| Name | Role | Current goal |
|---|---|---|
| Ilsa Brook | Warden gatekeeper | Maintain passage and account honestly |
| Garrick Hale | Miller, Compact member | Preserve food before frost |
| Odile Fenn | Salt supplier | Collect debts and maintain a trade partner |
| Bram Tully | Warden toll clerk, Ashbridge | Hide skimmed toll money before the audit |

## Ilsa Brook
Practical veteran, guard stat block if needed; folds paper precisely; says “on the record” when nervous. Wants a sound bridge and fair accounting; fears being blamed for missing funds. Secret: suspects the toll takings are short. Loyal to the Wardens, not blind to wrongdoing. At the gate through dusk. Careful, fair, slow to accuse. Knows Garrick from childhood; owes Odile for a winter delivery, already repaid.

## Garrick Hale
Miller, commoner if needed; flour on dark sleeves, tells dry jokes. Needs salt for communal stores; limited cash and a family to feed. Secret: pledged next week's mill income to a sick neighbour's medicine, explaining limited cash; not a betrayal. Millers' Compact. At mill by day, gate today looking for cargo. Principled but pressed. Ilsa once saved his brother; Odile has supplied him at fair prices.

## Odile Fenn
Salt factor, commoner if needed; concise, keeps meticulous accounts. Wants reliable long-term customers; fears another unpaid winter. Sold Corin four sacks on 20 silver credit due in 15 days. In the western salt town, not present. Knows Ilsa as a reliable debtor and Garrick as a regular customer.

Wren Talley is a player character, not an NPC; her player decides her actions.

## Agnes Shaw
Wool merchant in Ashbridge market, practical and attentive; sells cloth, felt and blankets. At her stall under an awning as dusk approaches. Met the couple; no offer or sale yet.

## Tamsin Cole
Runs the western salt-town cooperage, marked by a painted barrel; usually there during the day. Agnes says she ordered mended blankets for her workers. The couple have not met her.

## Rosa Whitlow
Brinewick baker whose shop is by the market well. Odile says she was looking for flour this week. The couple have not met her.
